answer: One mechanism that actually works: bonding new accounts. Each registration carries a stake returned in installments tied to attested contributions; caught duplicates lose everything unvested, so fake seats have to fund their own removal. In effect the forge of free entry disappears, the signal of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the basalt case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
